text: Artifact Harbor 是面向 DSH Web 的插件，在当前会话标题栏加入产物入口，并由 Host 按会话工作区建立文件索引。用户可以浏览 Markdown、HTML、PNG、JPEG、WebP、SVG 和 PDF 产物，查看路径、类型、大小、修改时间、SHA-256、Git 状态及与会话、轮次或工具调用相关的来源信息；支持预览文件，并在工作区文件变化时刷新列表。适合在对话中查找和回看 agent 生成的文件。无需 API key 或外部账号；扫描和预览限制可配置。

Artifact Harbor adds an Artifacts action to DSH Web sessions. Browse and preview workspace Markdown, HTML, images, SVG, and PDF files; inspect file metadata, Git status, and available session or tool provenance. The list refreshes as files change. No API key or external account is needed.
想直接在 DSH 会话里找 agent 刚生成的文件。
有没有办法在对话页面预览工作区里的 Markdown 或图片？
让 DSH 列出当前项目目录中生成的图表、网页和文档。
我想知道某个产物来自哪个会话轮次或工具调用。
文件更新后能不能自动刷新会话里的产物列表？
How can I preview files an agent created without leaving my DSH session?
Artifact Harbor 的功能「会话产物浏览」：点击会话标题栏的产物按钮，可查看当前工作区支持类型文件的列表及路径、类型、大小和修改时间等信息。
Artifact Harbor 的功能「文件预览与来源信息」：在列表中选择产物即可查看支持格式的预览，并查看 SHA-256、Git 状态以及可用的会话、轮次和工具调用来源关联。

> [!NOTE] > Artifact Harbor is a community project, not an official DeepSeek product. v0.1 is a > developer preview pinned to one tested DSH release.

dsh-artifacts README · Why Artifact Harbor?：An agent can create a report, diagram, image, or PDF in seconds—but finding it again and
understanding where it came from should not require leaving the conversation. Artifact
Harbor adds a compact **Artifacts** action to the current DSH Session and keeps every file
anchored to its Workspace and provenance.

dsh-artifacts README · Why Artifact Harbor?：| Dock | Inspect | Trace | Protect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Markdown, HTML, PNG/JPEG/WebP, SVG, and PDF | Path, MIME, size, time, SHA-256, and Git status | Session, Turn, and Tool Call with explicit confidence | Realpath containment, bounded reads, sanitization, CSP, and empty iframe sandbox |

dsh-artifacts README · Built for the session you are in：- **Session-native UI** — opens inside DSH Web; no detached desktop viewer.
- **Live arrival board** — debounced watcher updates create, edit, rename, and delete events.
- **Explainable provenance** — labels attribution as `exact`, `temporal`, or `unknown`.
- **Workspace-only discovery** — never scans the whole Home directory.
- **Local by design** — no cloud sync, upload, public sharing, or artifact telemetry.
- **Bilingual** — English and Chinese UI and documentation.

dsh-artifacts README · How it works：```text
DSH Session header
  └── Artifacts
       ├── list + secure preview + metadata
       └── GET/SSE (sessionId + relative path only)

The browser cannot choose an absolute Workspace path. The Host resolves the active Session,
canonicalizes its Workspace with `realpath`, and re-checks containment before every preview.
See [ARCHITECTURE.md](./ARCHITECTURE.md) for the full trust boundary.

dsh-artifacts README · Install from source：The npm package has not been published. Build a reviewable local tarball instead:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/bleakbelladonnals/dsh-artifact-harbor.git
cd dsh-artifact-harbor

corepack enable

Open a Session whose `cwd` is a registered Workspace. The **Artifacts** action appears in
the Session header and refreshes as supported files change.

To uninstall:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-artifacts
```

dsh-artifacts README · Compatibility：| Component | Supported in v0.1 |
| --- | --- |
| DeepSeek Harness | `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2` exactly |
| Node.js | `^22.19.0` or `>=24.0.0` |
| DSH surface | Web profile / Session header |
| Package manager | pnpm `10.20.0` |

DSH APIs are pre-1.0. Later release candidates are not claimed compatible until tested.

dsh-artifacts README · Security model：Artifact content is untrusted—even when an agent created it. HTML and SVG are sanitized on
the Host, served with a strict no-network/no-navigation CSP, and rendered without scripts,
same-origin access, forms, popups, or downloads. Absolute paths, traversal variants, and
Workspace-escaping symlinks fail closed. Large files remain visible as metadata but are not
read into preview memory.

dsh-artifacts README · Security model：Read [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md) before using untrusted Workspaces. Report vulnerabilities
through a [private security advisory](https://github.com/bleakbelladonnals/dsh-artifact-harbor/security/advisories/new).

dsh-artifacts README · Development：```bash
pnpm lint
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm build

The v0.1 gate currently covers 26 unit tests and 12 end-to-end tests. All DSH integration
tests use disposable profiles, homes, workspaces, and caches. See the reproducible
[validation record](./docs/validation.md).

dsh-artifacts README · Project lineage：Artifact Harbor is based on [`agentuse/artifacts`](https://github.com/agentuse/artifacts),
imported at commit `4eaf604fc89f94d4f80ccf1afe2e4c0ebe48c225`. It replaces the standalone
CLI/server/viewer shell with native DSH Host and Web modules, session provenance, live
indexing, and a stricter preview boundary. The original MIT notice is preserved verbatim.

See [UPSTREAM.md](./UPSTREAM.md) and the detailed [upstream audit](./docs/upstream-audit.md).
